|os = {{Name|Fishing Treasure Chest}}{{Name|Artifact Trove|3.6%}} |sellprice = 300 }} The '''Ornamental Fan''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] at [[the Beach]], in [[Cindersap Forest]], or in [[Pelican Town]]. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] or [[Artifact Trove]]s. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. ==Donation== Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Dwarf,Penny |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Tailoring== The Ornamental Fan is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Bridal Shirt]].
